record.summary: Passive.GALE_WINGS has no PassiveEffects entry. It is read only in PokemonEntity.flyAway: whenever a GALE_WINGS unit flies away to a destination found by Board.getFlyAwayCell, every cell on the supercover line from its current position to the destination (both ends included) receives the EMBER board effect through Board.addBoardEffect; the effect is also added to an entity standing on such a cell unless it holds Heavy Duty Boots. Afterwards the unit moves to the destination (or skydives when the skydive flag is set), and enemies that targeted it lose their target. The EMBER effect is read in PokemonState.updateEachSecond: an entity with EMBER that has neither the FIRE nor the FLYING type and no Heavy Duty Boots takes 10 SPECIAL damage (requested 10, no attacker, so no AP or crit; applied by handleDamage with its normal defence, shield and floor handling) and is burned for 2200 ms. The three units' skill is FIRESTARTER, which calls flyAway(board, false) (skydive off), so the trail is laid when the skill moves them; other flyAway callers also exist (Twister, Whirlwind, Roost, Brave Bird, Plasma Tempest, a synergy and an item), and a GALE_WINGS unit going through any of them leaves the trail.
triggers: Any call of flyAway on a GALE_WINGS unit that finds a destination cell
